extractions.value: Somatosensory stimulation of the face or occiput, and auditory stimulation, produced myoclonus that retroflexed the neck and elevated both shoulders; no spreading movement to the upper or lower limbs was seen, and it was not evoked by tapping the trunk or the limbs. Somatosensory stimulation of the lower limbs produced myoclonus that rapidly stiffened both lower limbs; this was confined to the lower limbs and was not evoked by tapping the head and neck, trunk or upper limbs. Both types of myoclonus tended to weaken with repeated stimulation.

extractions.value: Paraneoplastic stiff-man syndrome associated with mediastinal undifferentiated carcinoma. Past history of tetanus toxoid injection at age 56. Antinuclear antibody was speckled at ×160. Tumour marker NCC-ST-439 was raised at 28.6 U/ml, fell to 8.0 U/ml postoperatively. Both types of myoclonus tended to weaken with repeated stimulation (habituation present).
extractions.quote: These findings suggest that this stiff-man syndrome may occur as an autoimmune paraneoplastic syndrome of CNS.
